text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
That should be everything on the shopping 
list. Shall we head back to the academy 
soon?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"This felt hat... It would look great on 
Cheval and Verxina."

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
If we wore matching hats together, I'm 
sure it would be quite adorable. ...Fufu.

text_block_list.name: Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me, customer. If you're choosing 
that hat, how about this brooch as an 
accent? It's a new item featuring a ribbon 
design.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Well, that might actually be nice!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Still, I'd like to give them designs that 
fit their images a bit more, but...

text_block_list.name: Clerk
text_block_list.text:
In that case, we have other varieties as 
well, so why don't you take a look? I'll 
go fetch them right now!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
――I'll take that scarf, then. Also, could 
you show me that barrette from earlier one 
more time...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Verxina lost track of time while putting 
together outfits for her younger sisters. 
As a result, she ended up slacking off on 
training.
